# @three-ws/agents

> TypeScript SDK for the three.ws v1 Agents API: create, start and chat with AI agents, run goals, automate, and trade from Solana agent wallets.

- Repository: https://github.com/nirholas/agents-sdk
- Documentation: https://nirholas.github.io/agents-sdk/
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@three-ws/agents
- License: Apache-2.0
- Part of three.ws: https://three.ws

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/nirholas/agents-sdk/blob/main/README.md): install, usage and full API reference
- [Full text for LLMs](https://nirholas.github.io/agents-sdk/llms-full.txt): the entire README as plain text
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/nirholas/agents-sdk/blob/main/AGENTS.md): conventions for coding agents
- [Security policy](https://github.com/nirholas/agents-sdk/blob/main/SECURITY.md)
- [Contributing](https://github.com/nirholas/agents-sdk/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)
